source_selection.selection_rule: Resolve exactly the official Flea3 sanity_ll source-group link from the frozen official index. Do not use a mirror, another camera, sanity, another EVIMO2 group, ETH3D, ICL-NUIM, TUM, Bonn, or any replacement source.

pre_access_order: Verify this contract and all upstream bindings without accessing any EVIMO2 path or network resource.
Exclusively create and fsync one claim containing this contract SHA-256 and the frozen source descriptor SHA-256.
Only after the claim exists may the official index or any candidate data path be accessed.
Hash the first complete official response and payload; that first complete content identity is final for this evidence version.

allowed_network: One GET of the frozen official download index after claim.
The single official target selected by the frozen source-selection rule, including ordinary redirects from that target.
forbidden_network: HEAD, DNS/API feasibility probes, mirrors, search engines, alternate archives, and replacement or retry after a complete but inadmissible payload.
Any URL selected using geometry or RGB algorithm outcome.
allowed_payload_reads: Source-native metadata, timestamps, camera calibration, camera pose, and generated depth or static-scene geometry.
forbidden_payload_reads: RGB image pixels, event images, masks used as an algorithm outcome proxy, optical flow, RCLE algorithm output, algorithm failure receipt, activation, implementation lock, or score.

geometry_rule.window_partition: For each source-native sequence in official manifest order, start at its first common pose/depth timestamp and form non-overlapping half-open 10 s windows. Do not slide, rank, recenter, trim, or replace windows.
geometry_rule.pair_rule: Use consecutive source-native depth timestamps with 0 < dt <= 0.100 s and pose interpolation brackets no wider than 0.100 s. Missing or invalid pose/depth abstains; denominator is never reduced.
geometry_rule.point_rule: Use deterministic 8 px depth raster sampling, positive finite depth, calibrated projection, radius >= 8 px from principal point, in-bounds rotation-only and full-pose projections, and nearest-depth retention for duplicate projected pixels.
geometry_rule.window_summaries: Median of each pair summary over evaluable pairs.
geometry_rule.admission_rule: Every non-overlapping window is reported. The role content is the complete set of windows satisfying all frozen gates. Admission succeeds iff at least one window satisfies all gates. Failure yields HOLD; there is no alternate source, sliding window, best-window rescue, threshold revision, or RGB inspection.
geometry_rule.threshold_provenance: 0.05 s^-1 preserves the prior static-approach gate and PB-H1 physical calibration; 0.75 positive fraction requires signed radial coherence beyond lateral 50/50 behavior; 0.80 preserves the paired-denominator canary guardrail. None may change in R0.

identity_and_independence.content_identity: SHA-256 of the first complete official payload plus exact source-native sequence ID and half-open timestamp bounds for every admitted window.
identity_and_independence.future_confirmation_policy: All EVIMO2 v2 Flea3 sanity_ll content, the admitted sequence/window content, and any same capture-family derivative are permanently excluded from confirmation for this claim.

forbidden_scope: confirmation, Kill Gate B, Replay, Android, human, safety, or production claims
